brands.name: Kaynes
brands.notes: Kaynes – "Touching Lives with Electronics". Colours, typeface and rules read from the Kaynes brand stylescape.

rules.notes:
• Tagline: "Touching Lives with Electronics".
• Brown red #AC212F is the primary colour; Emerald #34C969 is secondary; Autumn leaf, White and Black are tertiary.
• Gradient map runs White → Autumn leaf #DB5D04 → Brown red #AC212F.
• Set all text in Space Grotesk (Light, Regular, Medium).
• Icons are bold outline icons with chamfered corners – white lines with Brown red accents on black.
• Keep clear space around the logo as shown on the logo page of the stylescape (see Brand book).
• Logo may be shown in white on Brown red, Emerald or gradient backgrounds.
• Icons, gradients and graphic overlays from the stylescape are in the Elements section – use them as provided.

brands.name: KIS
brands.notes: Kodaikanal International School – from the KIS Style Guide 2019. Tagline: "A school the world needs".

rules.notes:
• Never stretch the logo, alter its colour or text, or place anything on top of or behind it.
• Keep clear space of at least x/6 around the logo (x = logo width and height).
• On backgrounds where the colour logo does not work, use the monochrome (white) logo.
• Body text: Calibri 11 black (never smaller than 10 or larger than 12); captions Calibri 10.
• Titles Calibri 20 Bold, headings 16 Bold, sub-headings 14 Bold – sentence case, left aligned, no underline or effects.
• Do not use orange or red text.
• No shadow, outline, emboss or WordArt effects on text.
• Use American spelling; dates as 18 August 2019.

brands.name: Kumaraguru
brands.notes: Kumaraguru Institutions – KCLAS (College of Liberal Arts and Science), KCT (College of Technology) and the Institutions mark. KCLAS colours are from its Style Guide; other colours were read from the logo files.

rules.notes:
• KCLAS blue is the primary colour; the 3 secondary colours are used sparingly, in balanced ratios.
• Logo uses KCLAS blue wherever possible; one-colour black only when only black ink is available.
• Exclusion zone: minimum 10 mm around the logo and from cut or folded edges.
• Primary logo comes first. The secondary emblem only where the primary does not fit, internal use only.
• When clubbed with a partner logo, KCLAS sits on the left.

brands.name: Zari
brands.notes: Zari – parent company. Sub-brands: Miln Town and Bijapur Lodge. Logo-file colours (v1) and Brand Guidelines 2026 colours differ – please confirm which is official.

rules.notes:
• Dark logo on light backgrounds, light logo on dark backgrounds – only on approved brand colours.
• Minimum size: print 5 mm / digital 30 px height (with tagline 10 mm / 60 px, stacked 7 mm / 50 px).
• Always scale proportionally – never stretch, squash or distort.
• Never: new colours, random gradients, diagonal placement, shadows, outer stroke, new spacing, logo without clear space.
• Secondary marks (Insignia, Favicon, Sustainable) never appear next to the primary logo.
• Avoid mixing more than three type levels in one layout.
